title: Match-3: Leveraging Elimination Mechanics to Drive Retention and Pacing
subtitle: A deep dive into Match-3 core mechanics, focusing on the intensity stratification logic for 3/4/5-match eliminations. Through quantitative analysis of satisfying elimination triggers and dynamic checkpoint control strategies, we reveal how to drive user retention via rule design. Content covers constrained random generation algorithms and level pacing, aiming to help developers build high-engagement elimination experiences and improve game balance.

breakdown.title: Why 3/4/5 Matches Are Critical
bullets: It determines the 'expected yield per move'
It dictates whether players understand the goal of finding larger matches

breakdown.title: How to Design Pacing
bullets: Provide stable positive feedback in the first 10 moves
Introduce blockades or objectives in the middle section
Create one major reversal or strong item in the final segment

breakdown.title: Constrained Randomness
bullets: Transform failure into 'one step away' rather than 'no hope'
